▍ Microphone                      ‹ Mac's input                    ›            
Mac's input: the Mac's input, whichever it is when you start talking.
  Microphone                      ‹ AirPods Pro                    › 
AirPods Pro: push-to-talk hears AirPods Pro.
  Microphone                      ‹ a microphone not plugged in    › 
a microphone not plugged in: it isn't plugged in now, so push-to-talk hears the Mac's input.
